item.title: Holes dent defect ect, 25th August
item.description:
Further Report – Pavement Hazard and Witnessed Fall I would like to add an important detail to my report regarding the dangerous condition of the pavement. I was speaking directly to a Council worker about the condition of the pavement and the hazards I had already reported only last week when, during that conversation, a lady actually fell because of the condition of the pavement. The Council worker witnessed the accident himself and immediately turned around and went to help the lady. I also went to assist her. I helped her sit down safely, got her a chair and gave her some water. She had a baby in a pram with her, which made the incident particularly worrying, as there was a very real risk of injury to both the woman and the baby. The fact that this happened while I was actually speaking to a Council worker about the pavement defects demonstrates how serious and immediate the danger is. This was not simply a theoretical concern about what might happen in the future — someone has now fallen in front of a Council employee after the problem had already been reported. I am asking the Council to urgently investigate the pavement, including the holes, dents, cracks, uneven surfaces and areas where water/drips are creating additional hazards. I have video footage of the incident and the condition of the area, which I can provide if required. Please ensure this latest accident is added to my previous report and that the Council employee who witnessed the fall is identified as a witness. I am extremely concerned that if the defects are not repaired urgently, somebody could suffer a much more serious injury, particularly elderly people, children, people with mobility difficulties and parents with prams.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Mottingham Road, Coldharbour, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
